objective: Guarantee completeness for the measured structured supplied-field English tasks with compact, search-derived schema realizers while leaving open-ended English on the frozen neural LayerCake core.

candidate_lock.handler_scope: domain-free supplied fields and email notes only

decision_rule: Derive exactly one symbolic-only host from passing search material. Reject without schema/value patches if locked validation fails. If quality passes, export and certify this exact host under sparse native CPU runtime gates.
claim_boundary: Bounded schema realization is not a claim of general symbolic intelligence, teacher equivalence, globally minimal information, or zero world knowledge.
